description: Breadcrumb-trail boundary coverage: a single typeless breadcrumb defaults its type to 'default'; a longer ordered trail mixes explicit and defaulted types and preserves a data object verbatim with deterministic (sorted) key ordering and non-string values; a five-element trail confirms ordering at scale; and breadcrumbs attach equally to an exception event (emitted after the exception fields), where a data-only breadcrumb still defaults its type.
